_comment: Staff-written bulletins. The five items previously here were placeholder fiction from the original scaffold and were removed once the site went live — invented announcements must never appear on an official portal. Add real items in the shape below; they merge with data/news-fb.json (synced from the PIO Facebook Page) and are sorted by date. Fields: id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), tag, title, summary, image (optional, path relative to the site root), imageAlt (describe the photo, or leave empty if the summary already says it).

_example.title: Headline of the bulletin
_example.summary: One or two sentences explaining what residents need to know and what to do.
